faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Field Assistant/Lab Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Chamber of Officer Incharge, Agricultural Research Station, Badnapur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years. Relaxation: SC/ST/NT/OBC As per rule.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 22,000 per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; experienced candidates preferred.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment will be on contract basis upto 31.03.2027 or earlier as per availability of budget. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing the interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and verification of original documents. Interview. Scrutiny and verification of original documents at 10.00 am on 06-11-2026. Interview at 11.00 am on 06-11-2026.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts filled purely on temporary basis up to 31.03.2027 or earlier as per availability of budget in the project. Appointment on contract basis; no claim for regular appointment under VNMKV, Parbhani.
